propositions: autodeploy.sh recreates the review-bot container without waiting for in-flight reviews to complete, killing reviews mid-execution during landing bursts
killed reviews are unobservable to existing health checks and CloudWatch alarms because no VOTER_ERROR is emitted when a process is terminated rather than failing
the reconciler retry path lacks the shutdown drain protection that the webhook queue path has, creating a live-lock where deploy kills review, reconciler retries, and next deploy kills the retry
deferral of deploys while reviews are in-flight prevents gate stall and is bounded by REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to ensure permanently-busy bots do not block deploys indefinitely
new AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT metric and alarm expose the previously-blind failure mode where the gate live-locks while all health signals read green
